<div id="cal"></div>


```{ojs}
{
  const events = [
    {
      title: 'Classes Begin',
      start: '2026-08-17',
      color: 'green'
    },
    {
      title  : 'Labor Day',
      start  : '2026-09-07',
      color: 'gray',
    },
    {
      title  : 'Fall break',
      start  : '2026-10-05',
      end: '2026-10-07',
      color: 'gray',
    },
    {
      title  : 'Thanksgiving',
      classNames: ['no_class'],
      start  : '2026-11-25',
      end: '2026-11-28',
      color: 'gray',
    },
    {
      title  : 'Last day of class',
      start  : '2026-12-01',
      color: '#880000',
    },
    {
      title  : 'Exam 1',
      start  : '2026-09-30',
      color: '#511d66',
    },
    {
      title  : 'Exam 2',
      start  : '2026-11-18',
      color: '#511d66',
    },
    {
      title  : 'Quiz 1',
      start  : '2026-09-02',
      color: '#9a4eae',
    },
    {
      title  : 'Quiz 2',
      start  : '2026-10-21',
      color: '#9a4eae',
    },
    {
      title  : 'Final Exam',
      start  : '2026-12-07T11:30',
      color: '#9a4eae',
    }
  ]; 
  
  const calendar = new FullCalendar.
    Calendar(document.getElementById('cal'), {
    initialView: 'dayGridMonth',
    fixedWeekCount: false,
    showNonCurrentDates: false,
    // initialDate: '2026-08-04',
    hiddenDays: [0,6],
    height: 'auto',
    events,
    eventDidMount: function(arg) {
      if(arg.event.extendedProps.hover) {
        tippy(arg.el, {
          content: arg.event.extendedProps.hover
        })
      }
      else if(arg.event.backgroundColor == 'gray') {
        tippy(arg.el, {
          content: 'No class'
        })
      }
    },
  });
  calendar.render();
  return md``;
}
```

```{ojs}
FullCalendar = import("https://cdn.skypack.dev/fullcalendar@6.0");
YAML = import("https://cdn.skypack.dev/yaml");
tippy = require("tippy.js@6")
```
